reason: A Feishu-integrated user interface for controlling DeepSeek Harness agents through chat, interactive cards, approvals, project selection, and persistent sessions.

summaries.zh: 通过飞书聊天和交互式卡片控制 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，支持项目选择、审批提问、流式输出和会话管理。
summaries.en: A Feishu chat and interactive-card interface for controlling DeepSeek Harness agents with project selection, approvals, streaming output, and session management.

capabilities: Provides a Feishu bot interface for DeepSeek Harness sessions
Renders interactive control-panel, approval, question, and streaming cards
Selects working directories and manages persistent agent sessions
Sends session exports and scheduled reminders through Feishu
Runs the underlying agent workflow after user requests and permission decisions
